item.title: Live Updates: Michigan Democratic rift spills into public view and more
item.description: Ahead of the 2026 midterm elections on Tuesday, candidates in key races — and President Trump — are making their closing arguments to voters.

item.title: Jet from Texas crashes near homes in Palm Beach, Florida, killing 9 on board
item.description: Details about what may have caused the crash had not yet been shared.

item.title: Trump says Iran war will be put away very soon, "one way or the other"
item.description: Earlier, President Trump predicted the war with Iran is "going to end soon," without offering any details, as Qatari mediators return to Tehran to push for a deal.

item.title: Golden State wins first WNBA title in franchise history
item.description: The title was won in the first Game 7 in WNBA Finals history.

item.title: Sen. Chris Murphy hospitalized following stroke
item.description: Democratic Sen. Chris Murphy of Connecticut was hospitalized on Saturday after experiencing a stroke, his office said.

item.title: British man returns home after 28 years of walking across the globe
item.description: Karl Bushby was 29 years old when he embarked on his "Goliath Expedition" across South and North America, Asia and Europe. After more than 10,000 days on the move, he's finally returning home to northern England. Ramy Inocencio reports.

item.title: Dangerous flooding hits Four Corners, prompting evacuations across U.S. Southwest
item.description: Meteorologists say a super El Niño and a subtropical jet stream are to blame for the heavier rain, more torrential storms and bigger floods. Akiko Fujita is in Huntington Beach, California, with more details, and Andrew Kozak is in the studio with the forecast.

item.title: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy reportedly "awake" and recovering from stroke
item.description: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy's office said the 53-year-old Democrat began feeling numbness in his arms while attending his son's hockey game, and he was taken to the hospital. It was discovered there that he had experienced a stroke.

item.title: Trump makes final campaign push in Iowa and Kansas as Republicans try to hang on to majority
item.description: For the first time in a generation, Iowans in this reliably red state appear ready to consider all their options as polls indicate a toss-up in the midterm election. Lana Zak is in Dubuque, where President Trump is making one final push to get his party to the polls.

item.title: Stevens endorses Rogers amid rift with El-Sayed
item.description: Haley Stevens, who had the support of the Senate Democrats' campaign arm in the primary, had previously said she was supporting the Democratic ticket.

item.title: Madness in Michigan after Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens endorses GOP candidate Mike Rogers
item.description: Democrats are furious at Rep. Haley Stevens after she endorsed the GOP Senate candidate in Michigan, Mike Rogers, over Democrat Abdul El-Sayed. Nikole Killion is in Lansing with details on how it all unfolded.

item.title: Florida jet crash that killed 9 sounded like bomb going off, witness says
item.description: A private jet flying from Texas to the Bahamas crashed at high speed in Palm Beach, Florida, on Sunday, killing all nine people on board. Cristian Benavides spoke with witnesses.

item.title: Ken Paxton campaign no longer has Alamo event scheduled
item.description: Attorney General Ken Paxton's campaign had said he would hold a rally on the eve of Election Day at the famed Texas landmark.

item.title: Fact-checking El-Sayed and Rogers on 60 Minutes
item.description: Ross Douthat sat down with both candidates as they made their cases to Michigan voters.

item.title: 4 Americans among dozens killed in train crash in Spain, officials say
item.description: The crash occurred on the morning of Oct. 28 in Urda, Spain, when the high-speed train slammed into the rear of another train that had stopped.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama navigates uncharted territory on the court
item.description: He's 7-foot-4, he's French, and he's playing like no other NBA player ever has. Spurs center Victor Wembanyama says he's finding his own answers.

item.title: 60 Minutes Transcript: San Antonio Spurs center Victor Wembanyama
item.description: Spurs center Victor Wembanyama can dunk without jumping, freeze defenders with his ballhandling, and drain three-pointers. Wembanyama, 22, is the new face of the NBA.

item.title: U.S. sanctions push Cuba to the brink, with healthcare at risk
item.description: More than nine million Cubans are caught in the middle as the U.S. and Cuba blame each other for Cuba's deepening humanitarian crisis.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed, Mike Rogers make final pitch to Michigan voters
item.description: Republican Mike Rogers and Democrat Abdul El-Sayed talk about their platforms, how they'd represent Michigan as senators in Washington and what it would mean if they win in the midterm election.

item.title: Cuba increasingly isolated from the global economy amid tough new U.S. sanctions
item.description: The basics have become luxuries in Cuba, which has been under communist rule and a U.S. trade embargo for decades. The Trump administration says new sanctions target the country's corrupt regime.

item.title: Michigan candidates Abdul El-Sayed and Mike Rogers: The 60 Minutes Interviews
item.description: Control of the Senate may be decided in Michigan, where Democrat Abdul El-Sayed is facing Republican Mike Rogers in a tight race. They spoke with 60 Minutes about President Trump, Israel and more.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama: The 60 Minutes Interview
item.description: Spurs center Victor Wembanyama can dunk without jumping, freeze defenders with his ballhandling, and drain three-pointers. Wembanyama, 22, is the new face of the NBA.

item.title: To honor America's 250th anniversary, vote
item.description: When it comes to politics, Americans are often too ready to complain, rather than do something. In this 250th anniversary year of America, they can change that by voting in the midterms.

item.title: 11/1/2026: Michigan Senate Race; Cuba in Crisis; Wemby
item.description: First, Michigan race: Abdul El-Sayed and Mike Rogers. Then, inside Cuba under tough U.S. sanctions. And, Victor Wembanyama: The 60 Minutes Interview.

item.title: 11/1: CBS Weekend News
item.description: Florida jet crash killed nine on board; fallout of Michigan Democratic rift and President Trump's final campaign push.

item.title: Judge tosses lawsuit seeking to delay certification of Alaska Senate race
item.description: The Justice Department argued that Daniel J. Sullivan's name on the ballot potentially diverted voters, and the Democrat running in the race would benefit as a result.

item.title: Creditor has "taken control" of forever cruise
item.description: Residents of Villa Vie Odyssey, which remains stuck in Cambodia, have been informed the cruise ship is now under control of its lender, CBS News has learned.

item.title: Binance resumes withdrawals for some cryptocurrencies after heist
item.description: The exchange said it would resume withdrawals in phases, pending security checks.

item.title: Rioters loot stores in Germany amid cost-of-living protests
item.description: After a largely peaceful protest, violence broke out between police and demonstrators in Germany.

item.title: Trump holds 27th campaign rally in 30 days as midterms near
item.description: President Trump is holding his 27th rally in 30 days on Friday, a sign of how competitive key congressional races have become as Election Day closes in. Weijia Jiang has the latest.
